cards.title: ◐ Claude Code
cards.reviewNotes:
I fixed both things on the Home screen and checked them on the iPhone 17 simulator (iOS 26.4). Typecheck and lint pass.

- **Top gap:** gone. The iOS tab bar already moves screens below the status bar, and my code was adding that space a second time. The same fix is applied to the Map, Navigate and list screens.
- **Emergency circles:** the row above SOS is now Medical, Fire, Police, Flood and Earthquake, and all five fit on screen. Picking one is optional:
  - **With a pick:** tap a circle and the hint changes to "Tap 3 times to send Fire alert". The triple tap goes straight to the 5-second cancel countdown with that type.
  - **Without a pick:** the "What's happening?" sheet still asks.
  - **To clear:** tap the selected circle again.
- **Flood and Earthquake** are both the thesis "Disaster" category underneath. The alert still shows the name the person picked.
- **Contacts:** they moved off Home. They're still in the small avatar row under SOS and in the Contacts tab.

The gear button over the Earthquake circle is Expo's dev menu, which only shows in development builds.

All the phase 1 screens from the plan are built with mock data: resident and responder sides of the app, plus the admin dashboard. Three things are still open:
- **Android:** no emulator on this Mac, so I haven't run it.
- **Dashboard map:** the map uses MapLibre with free OpenFreeMap tiles instead of Google Maps, because Google needs an API key. Map tiles didn't draw in my headless screenshots (no WebGL there), so check them in a real browser.
- **Not yet tested on the simulator:** the SOS flow itself and the VoiceOver / largest text size checks. I can't tap the simulator from here.

The new git repo in E-Alert has nothing committed yet.

Two servers are still running if you want to try it:
- **Mobile:** Metro on port 8081. Press Cmd+R in the simulator to reload.
- **Dashboard:** http://localhost:5199

cards.title: Run the mobile mode
cards.reviewNotes:
Mobile app running. Expo dev server up on port 8081, hot reload on.

I installed dependencies first because the workspace had none.

**Open it:**
- **Phone (Expo Go):** open `exp://192.168.18.233:8081` in Expo Go. Phone must be on same Wi-Fi as Mac. No QR code shows here because the terminal has no interactive screen.
- **Web:** http://localhost:8081
- **iOS simulator / Android:** run `! cd apps/mobile && npx expo start --ios` (or `--android`) yourself. Those need the interactive Expo menu.

Logs stream in background. Say "logs" to see output, or "stop" to kill the server.

cards.title: Remove the what kind of help text
cards.description: remove the what kind of help text
cards.reviewNotes:
The home screen now stretches the SOS area into the empty space at the bottom, and the SOS button is bigger.

- **Layout** (`src/app/(resident)/home.tsx`): the SOS area now takes up all the height between the emergency type buttons and the bottom of the screen, with the button centred in it. The "Your SOS goes to…" text now sits at the bottom, just above the tab bar.
- **Bigger SOS button** (`src/features/SOSButton.tsx`): the outer ring went from 268 to 312 and the inner button from 184 to 216. The "SOS" text went from 46 to 54, the icon from 26 to 30, and "Tap 3 times for help" is one text size larger.

The TypeScript check found no errors in either file, but I haven't looked at it on a phone. On a shorter phone the screen will scroll instead of squeezing. If the button feels too big, the size is one number at `src/features/SOSButton.tsx:17`.
